doc: Guinevere / Guinaifen (桂乃芬.pmx): aggressive style. Classes and regions from the UV-island review of every texture in the folder, 2026-10-25. The face sheet (颜.png) uses the anime-safe face classes; 眉目 and 眼线内 are now caught by the lash rule. Gold type decided 2026-10-26 (the user asked for one per character): painted gold is a mid-tone, so as a metal its reflectance (F0, the albedo's linear luminance on the mesh) is far below real gold's ~0.74, and at the aggressive roughness 0.12 it mirrors the dark room (Robin ZZZ's halo: 152 -> 96, -37%, in game). Satin yellow gold (metal roughness 0.32), same as Guinaifen (new_mmd_model_1c2ed2fc), whose layer wins every shared hash; this layer was not regenerated for it (shadowed).
